Precession constant from the RATIO of two cycles in one section

Source: R/k_from_ratio.R
k_from_ratio.Rd

Scale-free: the ratio of two cycle periods equals the ratio of the two wavelengths, so this works on an untuned depth series just as well as on a tuned record, and no sedimentation rate is needed. Solving T1/T2 = (p + f2)/(p + f1) for the precession frequency p gives p = (f2 - R f1) / (R - 1), R = T1/T2, T1 > T2.

Usage

k_from_ratio(
  long,
  short,
  term_long = "k+s3",
  term_short = "k+g5",
  age_ma,
  rel_sd = 0.03,
  record_length = NULL,
  mult = 1,
  nsim = 20000,
  method = c("angular_momentum", "astrogeo22"),
  seed = NULL,
  data_dir = NULL
)

Arguments

long

Period of the longer of the two cycles (numeric, > short), in kyr for a tuned record or in metres for a depth series; only the ratio long / short is used. Required (no default).

short

Period of the shorter cycle, in the same unit as long (numeric, > 0). Required (no default).

term_long

Astronomical term of the longer cycle (character), e.g. "k+s3" (obliquity), "k+g5" (precession) or an eccentricity term such as "e405", "e125", "e95" (see astro_terms). At least one of the two terms must contain k. Default="k+s3".

term_short

Astronomical term of the shorter cycle (character), with the same options as term_long. Default="k+g5".

age_ma

Age of the record in Ma (numeric, one value or c(min, max), of which the mean is used); sets the obliquity used by ctest_earthmoon and the AstroGeo22 reference values. Required (no default).

rel_sd

Relative one-sigma uncertainty of each measured cycle (numeric, >= 0; 0.03 is 3%); the cycles are drawn from normal distributions. Ignored when record_length is given. Default=0.03.

record_length

Length of the analysed record in the same unit as the cycles (numeric, > 0). If given, each cycle is drawn uniformly from the band set by the frequency resolution mult / record_length (see cycle_band) instead of using rel_sd. Default=NULL.

mult

Multiple of the frequency resolution used as half-width of the band when record_length is given (numeric, > 0). Default=1.

nsim

Number of Monte Carlo draws (integer, >= 0); 0 skips the uncertainty and returns the plain point estimate. Default=20000.

method

How the precession constant is converted to Earth-Moon distance, length of day and obliquity (character, passed to ctest_earthmoon): "angular_momentum" (conservation of Earth-Moon angular momentum) or "astrogeo22" (inversion of the AstroGeo22 curve of Farhat et al., 2022). Default=c("angular_momentum", "astrogeo22"), i.e. "angular_momentum".

seed

Seed of the random number generator (integer), so that the Monte Carlo results can be reproduced; NULL leaves the current random state unchanged. Default=NULL.

data_dir

Folder that contains the data tables AstroGeo22.txt and La04gisi.csv (character path). NULL uses getOption("cocoR.data") or the copies installed with WaverideR. Default=NULL.

Value

list with the Earth-Moon `summary`, `k_kyr`, `k_sd_kyr`, `k_ci95_kyr`, `ratio`, `samples`, `terms`, `reference` and `method`

Details

Either cycle may be an eccentricity term ("e405", "e125", "e95", ...). Pairing an eccentricity cycle with a precession or obliquity cycle is often the most robust option in an untuned section, because the eccentricity terms carry no k and are the best known frequencies.
